messages:
Ravi Desai: Quick poll 3c33fb3cb who wants to do a fast midday 'grip & gait' session Thu 12:20-12:50? 20 min boulder drills + 10 min jog. Reply + or -
Monica Park: + I can bring spare chalk and a mini resistance band.
Eli Torres: - got a meeting, sad. Can y'all do a 12:45 start instead?
Ravi Desai: We can push 12:25start to accommodate Eli if that helps. Still short session.
June Park: + works for me. Also can lead a 5-min ankle mobility drill for the jog.
Monica Park: If anyone wants to carpool to the gym after, I have two seats in the 1pm shuttle.
GymBot: Reminder: Weather is clear. Gym pads reserved 12:20-1:00.
Eli Torres: 12:25 ok for me then. Thanks for shifting.
Ravi Desai: Cool. Plan: meet at lobby 12:20, quick warmup, then 20 min boulder circuits, 10 min easy jog back to office. Bring tape if your skin's fragile.
June Park: Bringing a foam roller for post-session, leave in locker 2.
Monica Park: Also tiny prize: whoever hits the most climbed problems gets the 'mystery protein bar' :tada:
Eli Torres: LOL stakes are high. See you Thu 12:25.
Ravi Desai: Done see you all.
